title: Preferring dances to parades, funerals, and the George Jones make-up band
summary: He prefers dances, finds Carnival Day parades tiring and funerals deeply moving, never played with the Tuxedo, and explains Celestin missing him as a teacher.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: What kind of job do you like best?

Well I prefer dances. I prefer playing in where people are dancing. Those parades are all right but sometimes you get a job and it looks like they walk all over the city. In Carnival Day you've got to be in condition. You've got to be in condition to walk for Carnival Day. Who did you play for on Carnival Day, what clubs? I think it was the Garden District. I remember the Corner Club used to have some bands too. They'd have those rehearsals first. I used to go up there to the channel and hear those people. Yeah we rehearsed for them too, before they job. This is Sunday before Carnival. That's a lot of fun. It is. I enjoy it. Lots of jobs you get on is work. You're going to feel it at Carnival Day but I am about as much in charge of it. I am about as much enjoyment as Damascus. Yeah. That's fun. Might as well have a good time while you can. Oh yeah, all that makes time pass better. Do you enjoy playing funerals? Well I tell you, a funeral is a funny thing. People that went through that, it brings back memories a little too deep. Of course you can harden up and play them but I don't care too much about funerals. Now after we put the body down, you'll feel a little different. But when you're behind the playing funeral marches, that's plenty deep. I don't care too much about playing funerals. So I don't care too much about playing funerals. Did you ever remember to play to play to play to play to play to play to play to play to play Did you ever play with the Tuxedo or with George Williams or any of those jump up bands or anything? No, I never did play with the Tuxedo. I tried to, when I first started playing music, trying to learn how to play music, I tried to get in touch with Celestan. He was supposed to help the instrument. But he was so busy, every time I'd go to his house, be my luck to catch him out. So that's why Celestan, he didn't have a chance to show me any music. What I meant with John Casimir. Well that's the Tuxedo band? The Young Tuxedo band? No, I never did play with the Young Tuxedo. You told me something about playing with John and his brother Joe, did you ever play drums? Yeah. With George Jones. You said they were in that band. Yeah, well you see that was like a little make-up band. Like George Jones would get a job out and through the French quarters. He'd come and get John Casimir, Joe Casimir and me and the rest of the men would go and play those jobs. But that wasn't a steady band. Whenever he'd get a job he'd come in the house.
